Sidebar visibility requires hatch_spaces_enabled. Repeated saves preserve existing placement and sidebar order. Moving a reference does not grant editing rights. Client metadata is not accepted. Saving a received Cloudflare share also records its participation as accepted and reports the acceptance to the owner in the background, exactly as participation Accept does; an already accepted record is unchanged.daemon_artifacts_slides_rebuildRebuild a slide deckRe-derives a per-slide deck's outputs from its authored source: the combined document and the deliverables at the deck's root. Write the source over the file API first, then call this. Rendering happens in a private scratch directory that is deleted when the rebuild returns, so no validation renders are published and `.src/validate/` is left alone; it belongs to the agent's own build. Answers 200 with applied=false when another rebuild is running, when the source changed mid-rebuild, or when the deck could not be built; the previous deck stays intact in every one of those cases. A failed quality gate is reported, never blocking.daemon_artifacts_queryQuery artifactsReturns a pinned-first projection across web, document, and shared artifacts. Omitted placement preserves the complete catalog across Library and Spaces. With hatch_spaces_enabled, placement=library and placement=spaces explicitly select disjoint sets; explicit placement is rejected when the gate is off. Collection and pagination apply after placement filtering. Omitted first defaults to 50; first=null returns every matching artifact.daemon_artifacts_shareShare artifact appDeploys an artifact app.daemon_artifacts_removeRemove artifact appDestroys an artifact app deployment.daemon_artifacts_fetch_urlGet artifact app URLReturns the current artifact app URL.daemon_artifacts_subscribeSubscribe to artifact changesStreams one or more ordered artifacts.snapshot chunks followed by enriched navigation.items.updated and navigation.items.removed events as NDJSON. Omitted placement subscribes across Library and Spaces, and placement moves remain upserts. With hatch_spaces_enabled, placement=library and placement=spaces explicitly select disjoint sets. Moving out of an explicitly requested placement emits a removal on that stream; moving into it emits an upsert. Every reconnect starts with a fresh full snapshot.application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8Artifact change streamdaemon_artifacts_placementMove a web artifact between Library and the sidebarRequires hatch_spaces_enabled. Accepts local, V2 saved, and connection-shared web artifacts with their exact catalog artifact_ref and space_id. Connection-shared artifacts also require the connection feature gate. Atomically commits placement and sidebar order: spaces prepends, library removes, and repeating the current placement preserves order. Content, identity, capabilities, pinning, and recency are preserved. Returns the committed request as a receipt; consume the existing placement-scoped artifact and Navigation subscriptions and re-fetch tab order for current state. A disabled gate returns 403 spaces_disabled; stale or missing identity returns 409 artifact_changed; a full sidebar returns 400 sidebar_full. Malformed or unsupported references and malformed body fields return 400 invalid_params.
